title: Volley Claude Registry Changed
description: A supervisor's retained signal that its Claude account registry changed, published to volley/_system/claude/registry on every add, rename, remove, finished sign-in and sync, and at start. It carries no account: a client that shows the registry asks for it again (claude_accounts) when rev changes. See spec section 4.6.11.

rev.description: The registry's revision: 0 when the supervisor starts, one more at each change. A client compares it for equality only: a restart starts it again.

at.description: When the supervisor published this revision.
